pages.text: $(#FFD700)Seven core tools$() — all use the same XP, tier, and trait systems. $(#55FF55)Shift+Right-click$() when $(#FF5555)NEEDS UPGRADE$() to tier up.$(br2)$(item)Pickaxe$() — ores and stone.
